function: Above the physical layer: DRL (DDQN, DDPG) learns task offloading among satellites and cloud, and onboard computation resource allocation; link bandwidth is a fixed setting (pp. 7, 9, 10).
notes: Excluded as above_phy. p. 7: the higher-layer agent chooses where each task is conducted (local, neighbour satellite, cloud). p. 9: "computation resource allocation for offloaded tasks" is the lower-layer action. p. 10: bandwidth is fixed at 15 and 80 Mbps. No learned control of transmit power, beams, or radio resources appears. First page title matches the DOI (JCORA for LEO satellite networks with hierarchical multi-agent RL). Results are delay, outrange ratio, and load balance index.
